answer_model.instructions: Which model should write the reply to this request, if any?

criteria.claude-opus-5-5: Most requests: questions, explanations, advice, in-depth analysis, research-style knowledge work, long-form writing, coding, and system design; polished customer-facing replies and business documents; classifying, extracting, tagging, or labeling information from text; and creative writing such as stories, screenplays, dialogue, roleplay, and characters.
criteria.gpt-6-astra: Long agent runs that use many tools or operate a terminal or computer, large code migrations, high-stakes work where a factual mistake would be costly, a single very hard problem that needs long careful thought such as difficult logic or tricky quantitative analysis, and math: proofs, equations, derivations, or competition-level problems.
criteria.kimi-k3: The request is in Chinese or is bilingual Chinese/English, or it is long-horizon coding across a large repository, or it involves a very long document.
criteria.none: The request only asks to generate or edit an image, video, or audio, and that output is the whole reply.

search_model.instructions: Which model should search the web for this request, if any?

criteria.none: Anything that can be answered or made without looking things up online, including requests to create or edit an image, video, or audio.
criteria.perplexity-sonar-pro: Questions about recent events, news, prices, or facts that may have changed, answered by combining several sources with citations.
criteria.perplexity-sonar-pro-search: A question that needs several searches in a row, where later searches depend on what earlier ones found.
criteria.perplexity-sonar-deep-research: The user wants an exhaustive research report or a thorough investigation of a topic and is willing to wait for it.

criteria.none: Anything other than making or changing an image, including questions about pictures and requests for only a video or audio.
criteria.gemini-3-pro-image: Any image to generate or edit, including legible text, many reference images, and production-ready assets.

video_generation_model.instructions: Which model should generate the video in this request, if any?
